sources.title: PhishLens | Defensive browser extension and FastAPI backend for ...
sources.snippet: PhishLens is a defensive Chrome extension and FastAPI backend for explainable phishing risk analysis in real time. It combines local URL heuristics, privacy-preserving DOM signals, optional PhishTank threat intelligence, backend-side TLS certificate inspection, and an optional machine learning model.
